header: Sending email to AI controlled input values
content:
AIAgentsInfo
//Find agents with email sending tool via microsoft 365 connector, where the input
//parameters of the inputs are populated by generative orchestrator
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by AIAgentId
| where AgentStatus != "Deleted"
| extend IsGenAIOrchestrator =
tostring(todynamic(RawAgentInfo).Bot.Attributes.configuration) has
'"GenerativeActionsEnabled": true'
| where IsGenAIOrchestrator
| mvexpand Action = AgentToolsDetails
| extend  OperationId = tostring(Action.action.operationId), ActionName =
tostring(Action.modelDisplayName), Action
| where OperationId == "SendEmailV2"
| where isempty(Action.inputs) //All inputs are populated by Orchestrator
| project-reorder AgentCreationTime ,AIAgentId, AIAgentName, AgentStatus,
CreatorAccountUpn, OwnerAccountUpns, ActionName
